shorts_extract.hook: With arm muscles dead flat at zero, a premotor 'movement' cell in Parma fires over a speaker the instant a scientist pinches a raisin.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Rizzolatti et al.'s 1992-1996 F5 discovery (goal specificity, empty-air silence, hidden-apple & sound firing).
shorts_extract.twist: Gregory Hickok & Cecilia Heyes's vital correction: debunking 2000s 'explains everything / broken-mirror autism' hype while keeping real predictive motor learning.
